spectators.name: Shinji Ikari
spectators.look: timid 14-year-old boy with messy dark-brown hair, soft blue eyes and an anxious expression, wearing a white short-sleeve school shirt and black slacks, a small cassette music player clipped to his belt with earbud wires in his ears
spectators.fallbackLook: timid young teen boy with messy dark-brown hair, soft blue eyes and an anxious expression, a white short-sleeve school shirt and black slacks, a small music player at his belt with earbud wires in his ears
spectators.idle: earbuds in, slouched, glancing nervously at the ring
spectators.cheer: small hesitant fist raised, unsure smile

spectators.name: Asuka Langley Soryu
spectators.look: fiery 14-year-old pilot with long orange-red hair, two red angular interface clips in her hair, sharp blue eyes and a cocky glare, wearing a glossy red plugsuit with black and orange accents
spectators.fallbackLook: fiery teen girl with long orange-red hair, two red angular clips in her hair, sharp blue eyes and a cocky glare, a glossy red full-body pilot suit with black and orange accents
spectators.idle: hands on hips, pouting and glaring at the fighters
spectators.shocked: teeth gritted in furious disbelief, fists clenched at her sides

spectators.name: Rei Ayanami
spectators.look: quiet, ethereal 14-year-old pilot with a short pale-blue bob, red eyes and an expressionless face, wearing a white plugsuit with black and blue accents
spectators.fallbackLook: quiet, pale teen girl with a short pale-blue bob, red eyes and a blank expression, a white full-body pilot suit with black and blue accents
spectators.idle: standing perfectly still, expressionless, hands at her sides
spectators.cheer: a tiny raised hand and the faintest smile
spectators.shocked: a slow blink, head tilting slightly

spectators.name: Misato Katsuragi
spectators.look: carefree operations commander with long straight purple hair, brown eyes and a playful grin, wearing a short red jacket over a black dress and a silver cross pendant necklace, holding a can of drink
spectators.fallbackLook: carefree young woman with long straight purple hair, brown eyes and a playful grin, a short red jacket over a black dress, a silver cross pendant necklace, holding a can of drink
spectators.idle: leaning back, sipping from the can, winking
spectators.shocked: can crushed in her hand, eyes wide

spectators.name: Gendo Ikari
spectators.look: cold, imposing commander with short dark hair, a short dark beard, orange-tinted rectangular glasses and an unreadable face, wearing a high-collared dark navy commander uniform and white gloves
spectators.fallbackLook: cold, imposing man with short dark hair, a short dark beard, orange-tinted rectangular glasses and an unreadable face, a high-collared dark navy uniform and white gloves
spectators.idle: gloved hands steepled in front of his mouth, glasses gleaming
spectators.cheer: still steepled, the tiniest smirk behind his hands
spectators.shocked: glasses flashing white, hands slowly lowering

spectators.name: Pen Pen
spectators.look: small hot-spring penguin with dark blue-black feathers, a white belly, a spiky red crest on his head, round eyes, a yellow beak and orange feet
spectators.fallbackLook: small round penguin with dark blue-black feathers, a white belly, a spiky red crest on his head, round eyes, a yellow beak and orange feet
spectators.idle: standing still, flippers at his sides, blinking
spectators.cheer: flapping both flippers, beak open squawking
spectators.shocked: crest feathers standing straight up, toppling backward
